name: dog_motionbricks
layout: pose = 27*3 local joint positions (heading frame, root xz = 0, metres) + 27*3 world velocities in the heading frame (m/s) + 4 contacts; root = [vx side, vz forward, yaw rate, root height]

contact.note: channels offset..offset+count of the DENORMALIZED decoder output; > threshold = the foot is planted

inputs.cmd: [1,3] (command [side m/s, forward m/s, yaw rate rad/s] - root_mean[0:3]) / root_std[0:3]
inputs.root_hist: [1,4,4] (root values of the last 4 played frames - root_mean) / root_std
inputs.ctx: [1,4,166] normalized pose features of the last 4 played frames (the same tensor as pose_step ctx)

root_net.output: root [1,28,4] normalized root values of the plan frames 4..31: value * root_std + root_mean

seam.note: regular replan (cursor on a token border, command unchanged): tokens[0..carry] = previous plan tokens [c/4-1 .. c/4-1+carry] (given, known); decoder input = previous plan tokens [c/4-1-left_ctx .. c/4-2] + the new tokens; drop the first left_ctx*4 output frames
